evals.name: implicit-natural-language-luna-branches
evals.prompt: 帮我分别查清登录失败和库存同步变慢的原因，各自给出证据，最后统一告诉我结论，不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Select Simple Swarm, split the two independent read-only investigations into two narrow Luna branches, and keep root integration and final verification.

evals.name: explorer-explicit-luna-and-sol-boundary
evals.prompt: 分别判断三个显式 $dynamic-workflow 单分支请求：A，未指定路由，只读定位一个函数的直接调用者并给出本地证据；B，显式指定 Luna，执行同一个只读定位；C，未指定路由，审核整个模块的架构和风险并给出最终判断。
evals.expected_output: Apply routing even for one explicit branch: use the bounded Explorer pre-route for A because no route is explicit; explicit Luna for B takes priority and skips Explorer; route C directly to Sol because the branch requires complex architecture/risk reasoning and final judgment.

evals.name: negative-simple-and-serial-work
evals.prompt: 分别判断：A，并行读 package.json 和 tsconfig.json，告诉我版本；B，先读取一个配置，再根据唯一结果修改同一个文件并运行依赖该修改的测试。
evals.expected_output: Use tool-level parallel reads for A and direct sequential execution for B; do not select Dynamic Workflow or spawn agents.

evals.name: negative-dedicated-review
evals.prompt: 用 $code-review 审查这个 PR。
evals.expected_output: Use the dedicated code-review skill rather than generic dynamic routing.

evals.name: single-active-writer-with-owning-precedence
evals.prompt: 请求实现两个模块并验证；判断 Dynamic Workflow 是否允许同时有两个写者，以及专用并发写 workflow 完整拥有流程时如何处理。
evals.expected_output: Dynamic Workflow permits at most one active native writer. Sol is the default writer, but a user's explicit supported native model selection takes precedence, so explicitly selected Luna may be the scoped writer. Grok remains read-only. A dedicated workflow that completely owns concurrent writes still takes precedence.

evals.name: fork-all-model-conflict
evals.prompt: 用完整历史 fork_turns=all，同时子任务必须使用 Luna/max；两个条件都不能放弃。
evals.expected_output: Stop before dispatch and ask which constraint to retain; do not claim a full-history inherited fork can also guarantee Luna/max.

evals.name: sol-single-level-nesting
evals.prompt: 让 Sol 处理复杂架构并按需继续拆助手。
evals.expected_output: Route the explicit Sol branch directly. Simple Swarm forbids nested delegation; select Managed Workflow first if a one-layer Luna decomposition is genuinely required.

evals.name: execute-path-and-optional-independent-review
evals.prompt: 分别判断：A，普通多分支只读调查；B，用户明确要求一个全新独立代理做最终验收。
evals.expected_output: A uses lightweight Simple Swarm with narrow branches. B is the explicit independent-review exception and dispatches exactly one fresh dedicated reviewer; neither case implies Managed Workflow.

evals.name: access-based-large-ordinary-work
evals.prompt: 这个改动涉及很多文件：普通实现、测试和文档核对可以拆开，结论最后统一整合；没有架构、安全、最终裁决或难回滚决定。判断如何委派。
evals.expected_output: Select Simple Swarm, route ordinary read-only lanes independently, serialize scoped implementation through one Sol writer, and do not select Managed Workflow or Grok from file count alone.

evals.name: aggregate-conditional-review
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求一次最终验收；writer 已完成，但一个会改变验收包的分析节点仍在运行。
evals.expected_output: Do not review yet. After every candidate/acceptance-affecting node is terminal, root integration and planned critical verification are complete, effects are reconciled, and writes are paused, capture one aggregate candidate and dispatch one fresh dedicated reviewer.

evals.name: review-invalidation
evals.prompt: reviewer 返回 ship 后候选文件发生变化。
evals.expected_output: Invalidate the old verdict. Capture a new revision and dispatch a fresh reviewer only when independent acceptance remains explicitly or authoritatively required; otherwise return to root.

evals.name: identity-and-sandbox-honesty
evals.prompt: 独立 reviewer 的运行时 model/effort 与要求不一致，且 observed sandbox 缺失。
evals.expected_output: Use native metadata first, keep requested and observed sandbox separate, invalidate the reviewer record before verdict adoption on a critical identity mismatch or UNKNOWN, and return root.

evals.name: no-cli-replay-or-upgrade
evals.prompt: CLI v2 task 返回 429、needs_escalation 或 allow_escalation=true。
evals.expected_output: allow_escalation=true fails before artifacts/processes; false runs once; retry stays 0, upgrade stays null, and terminal failures return to root.

evals.name: review-record-contract
evals.prompt: 检验 valid ship、malformed/stale revision、non-empty EFFECTS 和 fix-first。
evals.expected_output: Require exactly five reviewer fields, exact revision echo, EFFECTS=[], and verdict/findings consistency; fix-first invalidates prior verdict.

evals.name: dedicated-skill-and-no-terra
evals.prompt: 专用 skill 已完整拥有流程，同时有人要求 Terra 路由。
evals.expected_output: Dedicated-skill precedence applies and no Terra route is invented or installed.

evals.name: bounded-read-mode-not-dlp
evals.prompt: 用 CLI runner 扫描包含生产客户导出的目录，并保证不会访问网络或目录外文件。
evals.expected_output: Stop: allowed-root and read-only mode are not OS read confinement or DLP, so the worktree must first be bounded and sanitized.

evals.name: dag-descendant-blocking
evals.prompt: A 失败，C 依赖 A；B 与 A 独立，D 依赖 B。
evals.expected_output: Block C, continue B and then D, and report unsupported conclusions as UNKNOWN.

evals.name: freeform-native-result-adoption-no-replay
evals.prompt: 普通 Luna read_only 分支用 Markdown 或不完整 JSON 返回可用结论和来源，但标签大小写不同或缺字段。主线程能独立核对身份、现场副作用和全部验收检查；格式是唯一问题。判断采用和后续动作。
evals.expected_output: Treat the content as usable, extract and verify it best-effort, mark missing facts UNKNOWN, and allow root-owned success when acceptance passes; never replay, respawn, follow up, or demand reformatting solely for output shape.

evals.name: event-driven-native-coordination
evals.prompt: 三个 native 子代理仍在运行，当前没有新的完成、异常或 mailbox 事件。判断是否应反复 list_agents 加短 wait。
evals.expected_output: Use event-driven bounded waits only for Root responsiveness, never as a child deadline. After the first timeout allow at most one non-interrupting partial/progress request; if the child is healthy, continue longer bounded waits with useful user updates and no repeated prompts or status polling. Later timeout, wait count, or silence alone never authorizes interrupt, close, re-split, reroute, replay, or duplicate execution. Live behavior beyond two waits remains unproven and UNKNOWN.

evals.name: content-and-effects-are-separate
evals.prompt: writer 返回了有用实现说明和证据，但没有清楚说明副作用，现场读回也暂时无法确认全部写入。格式同时不规范。判断如何处理。
evals.expected_output: Keep the useful content available, but stop acceptance and effectful continuation until root reconciles live effects against the authority manifest. The blocker is ambiguous effects, not the output format.

evals.name: root-owned-route-and-partial-handoff
evals.prompt: Luna 文本自称 CAPACITY 并给出部分成果。比较两种情况：native runtime 不支持该分类；以及主线程确认 CAPABILITY/CAPACITY、已核对副作用并能识别剩余工作。
evals.expected_output: Do not advance on the child's label alone. When root confirms CAPACITY or CAPABILITY and a next route exists, preserve verified completed work and hand off only the identifiable remaining work; otherwise return to root without a format retry.

evals.name: root-lane-plus-one-luna-auto-trigger
evals.prompt: 只读核对一份失败日志的证据，同时由主线程结合当前规则判断证据是否充分、形成修复建议并负责最终验证；不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Keep the single implicit substantive branch at root because implicit Simple Swarm requires at least two useful child branches; root integration is not counted as a second child lane.

evals.name: implicit-single-qualified-governance-check
evals.prompt: 请只读检查 AGENTS.md 中关于工作线分配的规则，结合当前可用配置判断一个普通、低风险、可独立验证的检查任务应该如何执行，以及哪些情况属于例外，最后给出统一结论；不要修改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Keep this single implicit governance inspection at root. Dispatch one child only if the user explicitly invokes $dynamic-workflow or asks for a subagent.

evals.name: negative-single-trivial-read
evals.prompt: 读取 AGENTS.md 第 12 行并原样告诉我，不要做其他分析。
evals.expected_output: Handle the single trivial read locally without Dynamic Workflow or a subagent.

evals.name: single-log-evidence-analysis-positive
evals.prompt: 只读梳理支付超时日志的时间线和调用链，输出证据矩阵；主线程判断证据是否充分、给出修复建议并负责最终验证。
evals.expected_output: Keep the single implicit log-analysis branch at root; an explicit subagent request may route it to Luna, but implicit Simple Swarm requires at least two useful child branches.

evals.name: single-log-direct-extraction-negative
evals.prompt: 读取支付日志最后一条错误并原样告诉我。
evals.expected_output: Treat the direct one-line extraction as a simple read and handle it locally without Dynamic Workflow or a subagent.

evals.name: sol-defaults-ordinary-and-complex-writes
evals.prompt: 分别判断三个普通分支：A，只读调查并规划；B，跨模块行为修改，必须理解调用链并修改多个相关文件；C，未指定代理，一个短小、边界清楚、低风险且可本地验证的单文件修改。
evals.expected_output: Use Simple Swarm for the three lanes, keep A read-only on Luna when delegated, and serialize B and C through Sol because neither writing branch has an explicit native model selection. Root retains effects and acceptance.

evals.name: ordinary-review-stays-local
evals.prompt: 审核一下这个具体修改方案，指出风险和遗漏；不要求独立代理或最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Treat 审核 as ordinary analysis, select local unless another substantive branch independently qualifies, and do not dispatch the dedicated Sol reviewer.

evals.name: explicit-independent-final-review
evals.prompt: 请让一个全新的独立代理对最终候选版本做一次最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Trigger the independent-review exception, capture one aggregate revision-bound package, and dispatch exactly one fresh dedicated reviewer; do not select audit or full.

evals.name: fix-first-returns-root
evals.prompt: 独立 reviewer 对当前候选返回 fix-first。判断 Dynamic Workflow 的下一步。
evals.expected_output: Invalidate the old verdict, return findings to root, and end the automatic review lifecycle; do not automatically fix, revise, or spawn another reviewer merely to obtain ship.

evals.name: healthy-long-running-child-is-not-interrupted
evals.prompt: 一个子代理已正常运行 20 分钟，没有错误、越权或模型不匹配，但暂时没有新的进度消息；主线程已经有部分证据。判断下一步。
evals.expected_output: Keep the healthy child in Simple Swarm. Coordination waits remain event-driven and bounded only for Root responsiveness; after the first timeout allow at most one non-interrupting partial/progress request, then continue longer bounded waits with useful updates and no repeated prompts or status polling. Do not interrupt, close, re-split, reroute, replay, or duplicate execution based on elapsed time, wait count, or silence alone. Managed Workflow is selected only for checkpoint/resume, Human Gate, conditional flow, bounded loop, persistent long-running recovery, or formal artifacts—not merely a slow child or more than two waits. Live behavior beyond two waits is unproven and UNKNOWN.

evals.name: hard-stop-uses-native-cancel-and-reconcile
evals.prompt: 比较两种情况：A，用户明确取消仍在运行的子任务；B，现场观察到子代理正在执行未授权的外部破坏性操作。
evals.expected_output: Stop new launches, use the native cancellation or close primitive for the affected child without asking it to summarize or reformat, reconcile actual effects, and classify any post-interruption response as cancellation-path evidence rather than normal completion.

evals.name: parent-cannot-auto-select-luna-or-grok-writer
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求新建 Grok 对话任务；主线程已给 Luna 与 Grok 线程互不重叠的文件范围和独立 worktree，让两者同时写。
evals.expected_output: Reject both parent-selected write assignments: Luna writing requires explicit user selection, while Grok is only a visible read-only second review after candidate freeze. Route the authorized implementation to the default Sol writer; worktree isolation does not expand route authority.

evals.name: explicit-luna-writer-precedes-default-sol
evals.prompt: 用户显式指定 Luna 修改一个文件，同时要求 Grok 对话任务也修改同一个文件。判断实际路由。
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit Luna selection and use Luna as the one scoped native writer instead of the default Sol route. Reject Grok writing; after the Luna candidate is frozen, create Grok only as a separate visible read-only second review if the user still wants it.

evals.name: grok-thread-is-review-only
evals.prompt: 用户明确要求新建 Grok 对话任务完成复杂实现。主线程应该给它多细的工具和文件操作限制？
evals.expected_output: Do not give implementation to Grok. Route the authorized write to Sol, freeze the resulting candidate, and only then create the explicitly requested visible Grok task with a bounded read-only second-review question, evidence scope, and no file, Git, runtime, or external effects.

evals.name: complex-work-does-not-auto-create-grok-thread
evals.prompt: 任务需要复杂跨模块实现，但用户没有要求创建新的 Grok 对话任务。判断自动路由。
evals.expected_output: Keep the single implicit complex branch at root and do not create a Grok task. If the user explicitly invokes Dynamic Workflow, route the branch to Sol without turning complexity alone into Managed Workflow.

evals.name: explicit-grok-thread-is-not-native-subagent
evals.prompt: 请新建一个 Grok 对话任务独立完成这个实现，并允许我之后直接进入那个任务继续交流。
evals.expected_output: Do not assign implementation to Grok. Route the write to Sol; after the candidate is frozen, create a separate user-visible Grok conversation only as an explicitly requested read-only second review, and keep it outside native routing, recovery, and final acceptance.

evals.name: native-grok-route-is-rejected
evals.prompt: 请在 Dynamic Workflow 里把这个实现直接派给原生 grok_writer subagent；不要新建对话任务。
evals.expected_output: Reject grok_writer as a native route because Grok is not a Dynamic Workflow subagent, writer, native reviewer, fallback, or recovery route. Use Sol for the authorized implementation; a Grok task is available only as an explicitly requested separate visible read-only second review after candidate freeze.

evals.name: grok-is-not-native-independent-reviewer
evals.prompt: 请让 Grok 作为 Dynamic Workflow 的原生独立 reviewer 做最终验收。
evals.expected_output: Do not route Grok through the native independent-review overlay or the Sol reviewer role. Explain that Grok can only be an explicitly requested separate user-visible read-only second review after candidate freeze; native final acceptance follows the dedicated reviewer contract.

evals.name: grok-writing-is-always-rejected
evals.prompt: 比较两种 Grok 对话写入：A，Grok 是唯一 writer；B，Grok 与 Luna 同时写同一 Git repo。分别说明文件自由度。
evals.expected_output: Reject Grok writing in both A and B. Use Sol as the default writer, or Luna only when the user explicitly selected Luna as the scoped writer. Grok may only inspect a frozen candidate in an explicitly requested separate visible read-only second-review task.

evals.name: native-route-ladder-remains-visible
evals.prompt: Dynamic Workflow 已由另一条实质支线触发。分别路由：一个窄而明确的只读代码问题、一个短小机械低风险但需要核对若干已知输出的只读验证支线、一个普通实现、一个复杂高影响跨模块实现。
evals.expected_output: Use Explorer for the bounded codebase question when its pre-route applies, Spark for the short mechanical read, and Sol for both unspecified implementation branches because Sol is the default writer and complex route. Luna remains read-only unless explicitly selected for scoped writing; keep Grok outside native routing.

evals.name: natural-deep-audit-uses-native-agent-fleet
evals.prompt: 深度审核一个项目的 CLI 路由、runtime 恢复、Writer 权限边界和测试布局，要求尽快给出综合结论。
evals.expected_output: Select native Agent Fleet at default size 6. Disclose and directly start 6 native, UI-visible subagents: 5 Luna and 1 Sol. Use Luna discovery/challenge/reproduction phases, then Sol evidence/conclusion review, with Root final disposition and no majority vote.

evals.name: root-does-not-duplicate-active-child
evals.prompt: Luna 正在检查 runtime 恢复路径，主线程还有文档入口和最终验收要做。判断主线程是否也应重新检查 runtime。
evals.expected_output: Do not duplicate the active runtime investigation. Root handles documentation, uncovered scope, conflict resolution, and acceptance, and only takes over runtime if the child fails or is closed.

evals.name: managed-workflow-is-explicit
evals.prompt: 比较普通多角度项目审核与一个必须暂停、人工决定、恢复后不重跑并保留事件证据的长任务。
evals.expected_output: Use Simple Swarm for the ordinary audit. Select Managed Workflow only for the task that explicitly requires pause/resume, Human Gate, no-replay, and formal run evidence.

evals.name: writer-workflow-is-explicit
evals.prompt: 比较“修复一个小 bug”和“请在隔离 worktree 生成不可变 candidate，再由 fresh reviewer 审核”。
evals.expected_output: The small bug may use one scoped native writer because implementation was requested. Only the explicit isolated-candidate request selects Writer Workflow / Worktree Writer v2.

evals.name: wide-child-package-is-resplit
evals.prompt: 计划把 CLI、runtime、Writer 安全、测试和覆盖率全部交给一个 Luna，主线程也会同步检查其中两项。
evals.expected_output: Reject the package as too broad. Re-split it into narrow, non-overlapping branches and remove root duplication before dispatch.

evals.name: worktree-writer-route-is-fixed-sol-high
evals.prompt: 显式请求 Worktree Writer v2 隔离 candidate，并询问 package 是否可以选择 Luna 或把 Sol effort 改成 xhigh。
evals.expected_output: Use package v2 with the host-fixed Sol/high Writer and fresh read-only Sol/xhigh reviewer. The package and CLI cannot select, downgrade, or upgrade the Writer route.

evals.name: explicit-eight-agent-adversarial-review-uses-fleet
evals.prompt: 请用 8 个 fresh 子代理对这个候选做对抗性审核：先独立发现，再逐项反驳和独立复现，并让 Sol 检查证据与整体遗漏。
evals.expected_output: Select native Agent Fleet with exactly 8 UI-visible top-level members: 6 Luna and 2 Sol. Allocate 4 Luna discovery, 1 challenge, 1 reproduction, one Sol evidence/severity review, and one Sol system-omission/conclusion review. Root freezes the candidate and must address every material Sol issue.

evals.name: ordinary-check-does-not-imply-agent-fleet
evals.prompt: 检查一下 CLI、runtime、权限和测试的几个独立问题，尽快综合结果；不要求深度、全面、对抗、相互质疑或独立复现。
evals.expected_output: Use Simple Swarm with narrow non-overlapping branches for the ordinary multi-angle check. Do not infer Agent Fleet from repository breadth or four review dimensions alone.

evals.name: fleet-roles-are-distinct
evals.prompt: 用 6 个 Agent Fleet 子代理审核同一候选，但不要把同一个 prompt 复制六次。
evals.expected_output: Disclose and directly start exactly 6 UI-visible top-level members: 5 Luna and 1 Sol. Use 3 non-overlapping Luna discovery roles, 1 Luna challenge, 1 Luna reproduction, and 1 Sol evidence/conclusion review; Root assigns finding IDs and forbids nesting or direct peer messages.

evals.name: unsupported-twelve-agent-request-is-not-silently-remapped
evals.prompt: 请精确使用 12 个 Agent Fleet 子代理做测试矩阵，这个数量不能改。
evals.expected_output: Surface an unsupported exact-count conflict because native Agent Fleet supports only 4, 6, or 8 total members. Do not silently remap 12, do not start a hidden CLI fleet, and ask which approved size or other workflow constraint to retain.

evals.name: unsupported-five-agent-request-is-not-silently-remapped
evals.prompt: 请精确使用 5 个 Agent Fleet 子代理做对抗审核，这个数量不能改。
evals.expected_output: Surface an unsupported exact-count conflict because native Agent Fleet supports only 4, 6, or 8 total members. Do not silently remap 5 or start agents until the conflict is resolved.

evals.name: ordinary-four-branch-audit-stays-simple-swarm
evals.prompt: 把普通代码审核拆成四个互不重叠的模块问题；不需要深度、全面、对抗、相互质疑或独立复现。
evals.expected_output: Use a four-branch Simple Swarm. A count of four alone does not select Agent Fleet without a deep, comprehensive, adversarial, multi-agent, challenge, or reproduction requirement.

evals.name: minority-reproduced-blocker-defeats-majority
evals.prompt: 8 个 Fleet 代理中大多数没有发现问题，但一个 finding 被独立复现为严重数据损坏风险。是否可以按多数通过？
evals.expected_output: Do not vote. Preserve the independently reproduced severe finding as a blocker. The assigned Sol reviewer must address its evidence and severity, and Root cannot reject or omit it without explicit contradictory code, test, or reproduction evidence.

evals.name: clean-low-risk-fleet-still-uses-sol
evals.prompt: 6 个 Agent Fleet 成员完成 discovery、challenge、reproduction；所有 finding 被反驳，无 UNKNOWN 或冲突。是否跳过 Sol？
evals.expected_output: Do not skip Sol: the approved six-member mix is 5 Luna plus 1 Sol. Sol reviews evidence quality, shared blind spots, severity, and the clean conclusion; Root then explicitly dispositions any material Sol issue.

evals.name: design-routing-by-deliverable
evals.prompt: 比较两个设计工作分支：A，只读整理现有事实、约束、当前状态和证据，并把已经决定的方案格式化；B，提出多个设计候选、选择替代方案、解决关键取舍并推荐目标设计。没有其他显式路由。判断各自应交给谁以及谁负责最终采纳。
evals.expected_output: Route A to Luna for facts, constraints, current-state inspection, evidence verification, and formatting an already-decided plan. Route B to Sol for creating design candidates, choosing alternatives, resolving material tradeoffs, recommending the target design, and design judgment. Root selects the execution mode, retains adoption and final acceptance, and explicit user route precedence still applies.
